title: Marvel Vs. Capcom: Clash of Super Heroes
note: Capcom CPS2 fighting game: health, health_p2, time, power, power_p2, 22 characters (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

_p1_ctl.note: player 1 controlled by a human (1) or the computer (FBNeo cheat database, Select Control (1st Char) PL1)

_p2_ctl.note: player 2 controlled by a human (1) or the computer (FBNeo cheat database, Select Control (1st Char) PL2)

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in % of the current level, full = 0x90, found in RAM captures under RetroArch on a cabinet (50, 95, 5 and 99 % of the bar read 73, 142, 2 and 143), the byte before the level

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in % of the current level, full = 0x90, found in RAM captures under RetroArch on a cabinet (50, 95, 5 and 99 % of the bar read 73, 142, 2 and 143), the byte before the level

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character (FBNeo cheat database, Select 1st Char PL1)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character (FBNeo cheat database, Select 1st Char PL2)

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat under RetroArch on a cabinet

score_p2.note: player 2 score, found with learn.bat under RetroArch on a cabinet (a two-player game), 0x400 further like his health

credits.note: credits, found in RAM captures under RetroArch on a cabinet (2 then 3 on the title screen, the only byte to do so, 4 and 5 in games), learned the same with learn.bat

power_level.note: super gauge level of player 1, 3 at most, its bar stays at 0 then (cheat Always have Max Super, confirmed in RAM captures on a cabinet)

power_level_p2.note: super gauge level of player 2, 3 at most, its bar stays at 0 then (cheat Always have Max Super, confirmed in RAM captures on a cabinet)

backdrop.note: stage backdrop, picks the HD theme in hd.stages (FBNeo cheat database, Select Backdrop Now!)

_p1_hp1.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (1st Char) PL1)

_p1_hp2.note: player 1 health of his second fighter in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (2nd Char) PL1)

_p1_on1.note: player 1, fighter 1 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p1_on2.note: player 1, fighter 2 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p1_chr2.note: player 1, character of his second fighter, the first one +0x800

_p2_hp1.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (1st Char) PL2)

_p2_hp2.note: player 2 health of his second fighter in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (2nd Char) PL2)

_p2_on1.note: player 2, fighter 1 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p2_on2.note: player 2, fighter 2 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p2_chr2.note: player 2, character of his second fighter, the first one +0x800

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)

hd.note: HD theme and place shown for each backdrop value (index = value), made by tools/cps_games.py from the stages of the cheat database, see README, HD themes
